name: harness-pilot-v1
purpose: Feasibility of a Track A comparison (upstage-cli vs mini-swe-agent) under one served model: accounting, stop reasons, context exhaustion, effort per attempt. Not a benchmark; no ranking or significance claim. ADR 0012.
instanceSelection: benchmarks/campaign/make_campaign.py pilot rule: psf/requests instances disjoint from datasets/swe-bench-verified/subset-v1.json, ranked by sha256('korean-agent-bench/pilot-v1:' + id); the first three. 1724 and 2931 are the v1 pilot instances; 1142 needs its official image pulled (owner approval) before execution.

A.budget: v1 envelope (harness/src/benchmarks/swebench.mjs ENVELOPE): 30 loop steps, 60 tool calls, 2700 s, 8192 output reservation (input budget 7372)

B.budget: upstream swebench.yaml: 250 model calls, 2700 s wall clock; vLLM clamps max_tokens, so the prompt may grow to 16384

B30.budget: as B with 30 model calls: a sensitivity arm matched by call count, not a turn-matched control

evaluation: official SWE-bench evaluator (benchmarks/swebench/evaluate.py, swebench.harness.run_evaluation), one predictions file per (arm, repeat); every scheduled attempt in the denominator
